note: Beside edition-period-places-every-column-of-the-named-unparseable-edition: without the entry, nothing guesses the topic edition's period.
fails_if: the build infers a period for an edition whose name does not parse (for example from the delivery year 2020) instead of leaving the occurrence's period unresolved

sources.description: Variant 2 delivers A (variable 5, CVID 20) only in the unparseable edition 'Födelseland'.
